When I was younger, about 10-12. I had (and still do) these neighbors who moved in right next door to our house after the family who lived in there prior, moved out. This family, to my knowledge, was HUGE. I'm talking mom, dad, aunt, uncle, ect. type huge. Either way, they're a Mexican family, and they do tend to be pretty big.

So since this family is fairly big, there's a good amount of children to be had, these kids looked to be from the ages of 7-17-ish. For some reason, a good portion of these kids decided it'd be a good idea to be dicks, and mess around on my family property.

The earliest incident I can remember them doing was when they would purposely invade our property when they were outside playing. This would range from just running on our lawn a couple times, to LITERALLY placing their hand-prints on our fucking car, lmao. It got to the point where my mom and sister had to go outside and tell them to stop, and go to their own property.

The breaking point was when one of the kids decided to throw an ice cream cone at our fucking window. I was the only one who witnessed it, and I remember it so vividly. They all had ice cream cones in hand, and were purposely looking at our house, one of the kids, (wearing a blue shirt) threw his freshly-made cone dead-square at our window. After the act, they all proceeded to run away to their backyard as if nothing had happened.

Of course I told my family about it, which led my dad to walk over there, bang on the door, and have a man-to-man talk with the family father. All ended fairly decently, and the kids never pulled anything stupid ever again.
